summary: Completed backend + frontend verification for PCAdmin support tickets: normalized ingestion, grouped customer ticket lists, bell deep-link routing to the correct ticket thread, five-status lifecycle, reply-thread rendering, and attachment visibility.
action_items: No functional defects found in requested support-ticket scope.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py remains very large (>5k lines); splitting support-ticket routes and helpers into dedicated modules would lower regression risk and improve maintainability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Used admin credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Verified support_message bell click opens Customers > Customer messages and the referenced ticket thread (not CustomerDetail). Confirmed grouped customer sections, open-count chips, ticket cards, status selector values (new/open/in_progress/resolved/closed), reply composer presence, and image attachment rendering.
rca of the issue: No new issue reproduced in this scope. Prior bell misrouting regression appears fixed: notification type 'support_message' now routes to {tab:'customers', section:'messages', filter:{ticketId}} and SupportTickets consumes deepLink ticketId correctly.
